question_en: Which statements are true for an ideal LC circuit? 1) the total electromagnetic energy does not change; 2) if the inductance increases, the frequency increases; 3) when the capacitor charge is zero, the current is largest; 4) the energy oscillates with the frequency of the charge; 5) $T=2\pi\sqrt{LC}$.
question_uz: Ideal tebranish konturi uchun qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) to'liq elektromagnit energiya o'zgarmaydi; 2) induktivlik ortsa, chastota ortadi; 3) kondensator zaryadi nolga teng paytda tok eng katta; 4) energiya zaryad chastotasi bilan tebranadi; 5) $T=2\pi\sqrt{LC}$.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны для идеального колебательного контура? 1) полная электромагнитная энергия не меняется; 2) при увеличении индуктивности частота растёт; 3) когда заряд конденсатора равен нулю, ток наибольший; 4) энергия колеблется с частотой заряда; 5) $T=2\pi\sqrt{LC}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. L ortsa chastota kamayadi (2 noto'g'ri); W(E) = W·cos²ω₀t energiya 2ω₀ chastota bilan tebranadi (4 noto'g'ri).
Asos: Tomson formulasi, energiya.

distractors.D: chastota induktivlik bilan ortadi deb olingan
distractors.E: energiya zaryad chastotasi bilan tebranadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: принято, что частота растёт с индуктивностью
distractors_ru.E: принято, что энергия колеблется с частотой заряда

distractors_en.D: the frequency was taken to grow with the inductance
distractors_en.E: the energy was taken to oscillate at the charge frequency

question_en: Which formula gives the angular frequency of free oscillations in an ideal LC circuit?
question_uz: Ideal tebranish konturidagi erkin tebranishlarning siklik chastotasi qaysi formula bilan topiladi?
question_ru: По какой формуле находится циклическая частота свободных колебаний в идеальном колебательном контуре?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Mayatnikdagi ω₀ = √(k/m) da m → L, k → 1/C: ω₀ = 1/√(LC).
Asos: kontur tenglamasi q″ + q/(LC) = 0.

distractors_ru.D: это период, а не циклическая частота

distractors_en.A: the reciprocal of the angular frequency — a time
distractors_en.B: this is the characteristic impedance of the circuit (in ohms)
distractors_en.D: this is the period, not the angular frequency
distractors_en.E: this is the reciprocal of the characteristic impedance

question_en: The current in a circuit changes as $i=0.2\cos\left(400\pi t+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$ ($i$ in amperes, $t$ in seconds). Find the period of the oscillations ($\mathrm{ms}$).
question_uz: Konturdagi tok $i=0.2\cos\left(400\pi t+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$ qonun bo'yicha o'zgaradi ($i$ — amperda, $t$ — sekundda). Tebranishlar davrini toping ($\mathrm{ms}$).
question_ru: Ток в контуре меняется по закону $i=0.2\cos\left(400\pi t+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$ ($i$ — в амперах, $t$ — в секундах). Найдите период колебаний ($\mathrm{ms}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. ω = 400π rad/s, T = 2π/ω = 1/200 s = 5 ms. Boshlang'ich faza davrga ta'sir qilmaydi.
Asos: T = 2π/ω.

distractors.B: ω/π chastota deb olingan (2 ko'paytuvchi tushib qolgan)

distractors_en.B: ω/π was taken as the frequency (the factor 2 was lost)
distractors_en.C: the frequency (Hz) was found instead of the period

question_en: The capacitor charge changes as $q=2\cdot10^{-6}\cos(4\cdot10^5t)$ ($q$ in coulombs). Find the amplitude of the current in the circuit ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_uz: Kondensator zaryadi $q=2\cdot10^{-6}\cos(4\cdot10^5t)$ qonun bo'yicha o'zgaradi ($q$ — kulonda). Konturdagi tok kuchining amplitudasini toping ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_ru: Заряд конденсатора меняется по закону $q=2\cdot10^{-6}\cos(4\cdot10^5t)$ ($q$ — в кулонах). Найдите амплитуду силы тока в контуре ($\mathrm{A}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. I(m) = q(m)·ω = 2·10⁻⁶·4·10⁵ = 0,8 A.
Asos: i = q′, I(m) = q(m)ω.

distractors_en.B: divided by ω instead of multiplied
distractors_en.C: ν = ω/2π was used instead of ω

question_en: A circuit consists of a coil of inductance $2\cdot10^{-5}\ \mathrm{H}$ and a capacitor of capacitance $5\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Find the period of the oscillations ($\mu\mathrm{s}$; $\pi=3$).
question_uz: Kontur induktivligi $2\cdot10^{-5}\ \mathrm{H}$ bo'lgan g'altak va sig'imi $5\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ bo'lgan kondensatordan iborat. Tebranishlar davrini toping ($\mu\mathrm{s}$; $\pi=3$).
question_ru: Контур состоит из катушки индуктивностью $2\cdot10^{-5}\ \mathrm{H}$ и конденсатора ёмкостью $5\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Найдите период колебаний ($\mu\mathrm{s}$; $\pi=3$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. LC = 10⁻¹⁰ s², √(LC) = 10⁻⁵ s, T = 2·3·10⁻⁵ = 60 μs.
Asos: Tomson formulasi.

distractors_en.C: the frequency (kHz) was found instead of the period

question_en: The inductance of the coil of a circuit was increased $2$ times and the capacitance of the capacitor $8$ times. By what factor does the period of free oscillations increase?
question_uz: Konturdagi g'altak induktivligi $2$ marta, kondensator sig'imi $8$ marta oshirildi. Erkin tebranishlar davri necha marta ortadi?
question_ru: Индуктивность катушки контура увеличили в $2$ раза, ёмкость конденсатора — в $8$ раз. Во сколько раз увеличится период свободных колебаний?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. T ∼ √(LC): √(2·8) = √16 = 4.
Asos: Tomson formulasi.

distractors_en.A: the square root was not taken
distractors_en.C: the change of inductance was ignored: √8
distractors_en.D: only the capacitance was taken, without the root
distractors_en.E: the ratio of frequencies was found instead of periods

question_en: The space between the plates of the air capacitor of a circuit was filled with a dielectric of relative permittivity $2.25$. Find the frequency ratio $\frac{\nu_2}{\nu_1}$.
question_uz: Konturdagi havo kondensatori qoplamalari orasi dielektrik singdiruvchanligi $2.25$ bo'lgan dielektrik bilan to'ldirildi. Chastotalar nisbati $\frac{\nu_2}{\nu_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: Пространство между обкладками воздушного конденсатора контура заполнили диэлектриком с диэлектрической проницаемостью $2.25$. Найдите отношение частот $\frac{\nu_2}{\nu_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. C₂ = 2,25C₁, ν ∼ 1/√C: ν₂/ν₁ = 1/√2,25 = 2/3.
Asos: C = εε₀S/d, Tomson formulasi.

distractors.E: dielektrik chastotaga ta'sir qilmaydi deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: частота растёт и не извлечён корень
distractors_ru.E: принято, что диэлектрик не влияет на частоту

distractors_en.A: the square root was not taken
distractors_en.B: the frequency was taken to increase
distractors_en.D: the frequency was taken to increase, without the root
distractors_en.E: the dielectric was assumed not to affect the frequency

question_en: In the circuit in the figure, closing the switch $K$ connects a capacitor of capacitance $15C$ in parallel with the capacitor $C$. Find the ratio of the periods of free oscillations $\frac{T_2}{T_1}$.
question_uz: Rasmdagi konturda $K$ kalit ulanganda $C$ sig'imli kondensatorga $15C$ sig'imli kondensator parallel ulanadi. Erkin tebranishlar davrlari nisbati $\frac{T_2}{T_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: В контуре на рисунке при замыкании ключа $K$ к конденсатору ёмкостью $C$ параллельно подключается конденсатор ёмкостью $15C$. Найдите отношение периодов свободных колебаний $\frac{T_2}{T_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Parallel: C₂ = C + 15C = 16C, T ∼ √C: T₂/T₁ = √16 = 4.
Asos: parallel ulash, Tomson formulasi.

distractors_en.B: the square root was not taken
distractors_en.C: the period was taken to decrease
distractors_en.D: the capacitors were taken as connected in series
distractors_en.E: only the capacitance of the added capacitor was taken

question_en: What capacitance must be connected to a coil of inductance $50\ \mathrm{mH}$ for the oscillation frequency of the circuit to be $500\ \mathrm{Hz}$ ($\mu\mathrm{F}$; $\pi^2=10$)?
question_uz: Induktivligi $50\ \mathrm{mH}$ bo'lgan g'altakka qanday sig'imli kondensator ulansa, konturdagi tebranishlar chastotasi $500\ \mathrm{Hz}$ bo'ladi ($\mu\mathrm{F}$; $\pi^2=10$)?
question_ru: Конденсатор какой ёмкости нужно подключить к катушке индуктивностью $50\ \mathrm{mH}$, чтобы частота колебаний в контуре была $500\ \mathrm{Hz}$ ($\mu\mathrm{F}$; $\pi^2=10$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. C = 1/(4π²ν²L) = 1/(40·2,5·10⁵·0,05) = 2·10⁻⁶ F.
Asos: Tomson formulasi.

distractors.C: ν siklik chastota deb olingan (4π² yo'q)

distractors_en.C: ν was taken as the angular frequency (no 4π²)

question_en: In an ideal circuit, at some moment the electric field energy is $6\ \mathrm{mJ}$ and the magnetic field energy is $10\ \mathrm{mJ}$. Find the largest value of the magnetic field energy of the coil ($\mathrm{mJ}$).
question_uz: Ideal konturda biror paytda elektr maydon energiyasi $6\ \mathrm{mJ}$, magnit maydon energiyasi $10\ \mathrm{mJ}$. G'altak magnit maydon energiyasining eng katta qiymatini toping ($\mathrm{mJ}$).
question_ru: В идеальном контуре в некоторый момент энергия электрического поля $6\ \mathrm{mJ}$, энергия магнитного поля $10\ \mathrm{mJ}$. Найдите наибольшее значение энергии магнитного поля катушки ($\mathrm{mJ}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. W = 6 + 10 = 16 mJ o'zgarmaydi; kondensator razryadlanganda hammasi magnit energiya.
Asos: energiyaning saqlanishi.

distractors_en.A: the instantaneous magnetic energy was taken
distractors_en.B: the instantaneous electric energy was taken
distractors_en.C: the difference of the energies was taken
distractors_en.D: half the sum (the average value) was taken

question_en: A capacitor of capacitance $10\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ was charged to $200\ \mathrm{V}$ and connected to a coil of inductance $0.1\ \mathrm{H}$. Find the largest value of the current ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_uz: Sig'imi $10\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ bo'lgan kondensator $200\ \mathrm{V}$ gacha zaryadlanib, induktivligi $0.1\ \mathrm{H}$ bo'lgan g'altakka ulandi. Tokning eng katta qiymatini toping ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_ru: Конденсатор ёмкостью $10\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ зарядили до $200\ \mathrm{V}$ и подключили к катушке индуктивностью $0.1\ \mathrm{H}$. Найдите наибольшее значение тока ($\mathrm{A}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. CU²/2 = LI²/2 ⇒ I(m) = U√(C/L) = 200·√(10⁻⁴) = 2 A.
Asos: energiyaning saqlanishi.

distractors_en.A: the square root was not taken: U·C/L
distractors_en.D: I² was found instead of I (no root)
distractors_en.E: the factor 2 in the magnetic energy was lost

question_en: A charged capacitor was connected to the coil of an ideal circuit. After what fraction of the period does the magnetic field energy first become $3$ times the electric field energy?
question_uz: Zaryadlangan kondensator ideal konturdagi g'altakka ulandi. Tebranishlar davrining qanday qismidan keyin magnit maydon energiyasi elektr maydon energiyasidan birinchi marta $3$ marta katta bo'ladi?
question_ru: Заряженный конденсатор подключили к катушке идеального контура. Через какую часть периода энергия магнитного поля впервые станет в $3$ раза больше энергии электрического поля?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. sin²ω₀t = 3cos²ω₀t ⇒ tgω₀t = √3 ⇒ ω₀t = π/3 ⇒ t = T/6.
Asos: W(E) = W·cos²ω₀t, W(M) = W·sin²ω₀t.

distractors.B: elektr energiya 3 marta katta bo'ladigan payt olingan
distractors.D: butun energiya magnit bo'ladigan payt olingan
distractors.E: burchak π/3 davrning uchdan biri deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: взят момент, когда электрическая энергия в 3 раза больше
distractors_ru.D: взят момент, когда вся энергия магнитная
distractors_ru.E: угол π/3 принят за треть периода

distractors_en.A: the moment of equal energies was taken
distractors_en.B: the moment when the electric energy is 3 times larger was taken
distractors_en.D: the moment when all the energy is magnetic was taken
distractors_en.E: the angle π/3 was taken as a third of the period

question_en: A charged capacitor was connected to the coil of an ideal circuit. By what factor has the electric field energy of the capacitor decreased a time $\frac{T}{3}$ after the connection?
question_uz: Zaryadlangan kondensator ideal konturdagi g'altakka ulandi. Ulangandan $\frac{T}{3}$ vaqt o'tgach kondensatorning elektr maydon energiyasi necha marta kamaygan bo'ladi?
question_ru: Заряженный конденсатор подключили к катушке идеального контура. Во сколько раз уменьшится энергия электрического поля конденсатора через время $\frac{T}{3}$ после подключения?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. ω₀t = 2π/3, W(E)/W = cos²(2π/3) = 1/4 — energiya 4 marta kamaygan (zaryad −q(m)/2).
Asos: W(E) = W·cos²ω₀t.

distractors.C: magnit va elektr energiyalar nisbati olingan
distractors.D: to'liq energiyaning magnit energiyaga nisbati olingan
distractors.E: kondensator yana to'liq zaryadlangan deb olingan (T/2 bilan adashtirilgan)

distractors_ru.C: взято отношение магнитной и электрической энергий
distractors_ru.D: взято отношение полной энергии к магнитной
distractors_ru.E: принято, что конденсатор снова полностью заряжен (спутано с T/2)

distractors_en.C: the ratio of magnetic to electric energy was taken
distractors_en.D: the ratio of total to magnetic energy was taken
distractors_en.E: the capacitor was taken as fully recharged (confused with T/2)

question_en: The figure shows the graph of the capacitor charge of a circuit versus time. Find the amplitude of the current in the circuit ($\mathrm{mA}$).
question_uz: Rasmda konturdagi kondensator zaryadining vaqtga bog'lanish grafigi berilgan. Konturdagi tok kuchining amplitudasini toping ($\mathrm{mA}$).
question_ru: На рисунке дан график зависимости заряда конденсатора контура от времени. Найдите амплитуду силы тока в контуре ($\mathrm{mA}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Grafikdan q(m) = 3 μC, T = 4 ms; ω₀ = 2π/T = 500π rad/s; I(m) = q(m)ω₀ = 1,5π mA ≈ 4,71 mA.
Asos: I(m) = q(m)ω₀.

rules.ru: По графику: $T$ — время между соседними максимумами, $\omega_0=\frac{2\pi}{T}$
rules.en: From the graph: $T$ is the time between neighbouring maxima, $\omega_0=\frac{2\pi}{T}$

distractors_en.A: the charge amplitude was divided by the period (no 2π)
distractors_en.C: half the period was read as the period

question_en: In an ideal circuit with inductance $L$ and capacitance $C$ the largest voltage across the capacitor is $U_m$. What is the largest value of the current?
question_uz: Induktivligi $L$, sig'imi $C$ bo'lgan ideal konturda kondensatordagi kuchlanishning eng katta qiymati $U_m$. Tokning eng katta qiymati qanday?
question_ru: В идеальном контуре с индуктивностью $L$ и ёмкостью $C$ наибольшее напряжение на конденсаторе $U_m$. Каково наибольшее значение тока?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. CU²/2 = LI²/2 ⇒ I = U√(C/L). Birlik: √(C/L) — 1/Ω, demak amper.
Asos: energiyaning saqlanishi.

en: The largest energies are equal: $$\frac{CU_m^2}{2}=\frac{LI_m^2}{2}\ \Rightarrow\ I_m=U_m\sqrt{\frac{C}{L}}$$

distractors.C: C va L joyi almashtirilgan (birligi V·Ω)

distractors_en.A: the unit is V·s — not a current
distractors_en.B: the unit is V/s — not a current
distractors_en.C: C and L were swapped (the unit is V·Ω)
distractors_en.D: the square root was not taken
